name: session-kit
description: Hooks, a handoff skill and an iterate skill that every project can use: the owner's tagged lines (Do, Decide, Ask, Later, FYI) given ids written into the message and checked at a turn's end for a closing line each, a pre-send check by Haiku on a ?? message or one of four bullets, held on the band, context-pressure warnings (counting the tool output landed since the engine last measured, with the growth per turn, the plan's usage windows, a toast where no band is drawn, a band of rows with buttons that act, a status line, a pane and a turn line), git and test-run guards, prose-tells warnings, formatting with the project's own tools, a test-run log (each run stamped with the tree it ran on, a commit told when the last run failed or went stale, and the two-tries rule named at the second failed try), a direnv environment, a root pyrightconfig.json for multi-package repositories, the checkout checks (a missing or stale handoff, uncommitted work at the end of a turn), the suppression warning with its reasons and index check, a timeline of turns and tool calls with the time each of the kit's concerns took, the session-tells, session-codeintel, session-intent (with its id allocator), session-transcripts (with the chains of sessions and each one's own cost, what a session read or ran again, and the asks that recur), session-suppressions, session-rulebook, session-docs, session-watched (a run ended with its diagnostics after five minutes with no progress) and session-owed (what a range of history leaves to do outside the code) commands, and a looks check, a layers pack, a code measure, the quality gates (duplicates, fallbacks, file length), a footprint gate holding a plugin's reach to the reasons written for it, a review's mechanical third written into the review from a plugin cloned for it, and the project template in session-codeintel, CLAUDE.local.md handoffs with a section of facts the kit reads from git and its own records, and a fast-working mode for while the owner iterates.

thresholdTokens.title: Context warning from
thresholdTokens.description: Tokens of context past which the model is warned to find a clear point, firmer at 1.2 times and at 1.6 times that; 0 turns the count off.

threshold.title: Context warning percent
threshold.description: The alternative: percent of the context window past which the model is warned; 0 (the default) leaves it to the token count, and with both set the first reached warns.

step.title: Context warning step
step.description: Tokens the context has to grow past the last warning before it is warned again.

chain.title: Handoff chain
chain.description: The clear_point tool, after which the handoff, the compaction and the continue run when the turn ends, or stop when the next step is the owner's, a Haiku judge reading the chain at its third, fifth and every signal from the seventh with nobody at the prompt and stopping it on a loop or a step beyond the task; the new_task tool, after which the band offers the handoff and a clear, or to keep going here, and sends the prompt again, with the clear at an effort the model proposed for the new task when it differs from the session's; and the cold-cache timer, which runs the handoff and the compaction when a turn's end is left alone past the floor.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheMinutes.description: Minutes the prompt cache lives after a request: 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key. What the engine states (a subagent's result, a model switch) replaces it. 0 turns the cold-cache timer off.

cacheLeadMinutes.title: Cold-cache lead
cacheLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before the cache's lifetime runs out at which, with nobody at the prompt since the turn ended, session-kit writes the handoff and compacts the context, so the next prompt writes a small context instead of all of it. A 5-minute cache leaves no lead and arms no timer.

cacheFloorTokens.title: Cold-cache floor
cacheFloorTokens.description: Tokens of context below which the cold-cache timer does not arm: a small context costs less to write again than to compact. 0 takes the context warning's own trigger.

measure.title: Timeline
measure.description: One JSON line per turn, tool call and session end, with the time each of the kit's concerns took and the context it added, the session a clear or a resume came from, and the engine's token count of the memory files once per context, written at each turn's end under ~/.claude/session-kit/measure/<session id>/ for session-transcripts and session-rulebook to read. Nothing deletes the files.

docLines.title: Document length cap
docLines.description: Lines past which a markdown file under docs/ is named to the model after an edit, to be split.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: A line under the prompt that keeps the context figure, each usage window and the cold-cache timer in view on every surface. Off, the band draws a usage window from 80% instead of 95%.
